h: Capital of the Vijayanagara Empire, one of the great empires of South India. Its ruins, including the Virupaksha and Vittala temples, are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
w: Cycle between giant boulders and stone temples at sunrise.
k: How do I get to Hampi?

h: Amba Vilas Palace is the home of the Wadiyar kings. It was rebuilt after a fire destroyed the old wooden palace. It is lit with thousands of bulbs on Sundays and during Dasara.
w: See the royal halls, then watch the Dasara celebrations in autumn.
k: Where do I get a ticket?

h: The tomb of Sultan Muhammad Adil Shah of the Adil Shahi dynasty. Its dome is among the largest in the world, and the gallery inside carries whispers across the hall.
w: Climb to the dome gallery and test the echo.

h: Hoysala temples covered in stone carvings so fine they look like jewellery. Listed by UNESCO in 2023.
w: Look closely at the carved walls. Every figure is different.

h: The heartland of the early Chalukya dynasty. Badami has rock-cut cave temples, and Aihole and Pattadakal show early temple styles. Pattadakal has been a UNESCO site since 1987.
w: Climb the red sandstone cliffs above the Badami lake.

h: A 57-foot statue of Gommateshwara (Bahubali), carved from a single rock, stands on a hill. It is a major Jain pilgrimage site, with a grand head-anointing ceremony about every 12 years.
w: Climb the hill steps early, before the heat.

h: Founded by the saint Madhvacharya. Devotees see the deity through a small window. Udupi is also the home of the famous Udupi-style vegetarian restaurants.
w: Visit the temple, then eat a full meal nearby.
k: Can I get a meal here?

h: Founded by Kempegowda, a chieftain of the Vijayanagara period. Today it is a major tech city with Lalbagh garden, Cubbon Park and the Vidhana Soudha.
w: Take the metro, then walk through Lalbagh.

h: A misty hill region of coffee estates and the Kodava people, known for their own customs, dress and martial heritage. The Kaveri river begins at Talakaveri.
w: Walk through a coffee estate and taste fresh coffee.
